summary: A commission checks the dates on neighboring permits before treating a missing condition as an exception.
realLife: In defending the Nollan easement, the Coastal Commission counted other permits along the tract and explained that many without the condition predated the regulations authorizing it.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with commission, permit, rule date. A neighbor who remembers a different result can ask which rule applied at the time.

turns.what: A nearby permit without the condition turns out to postdate the rule.
turns.pulledBy: The neighbor brings a dated approval for a comparable property.
turns.writesBack: Staff must account for that exception in the comparison.
